_world.name: The infinite dungeon is a magical fantasy dungeon contain...

outpost_agrarian_sector.name: Outpost Agrarian Sector
outpost_agrarian_sector.purpose: Adventurers acquire mounts, rent beasts of burden, and gather agricultural supplies cultivated in subterranean pastures.

outpost_periphery.name: Outpost Periphery
outpost_periphery.purpose: Adventurers navigate fortified checkpoints, supply caches, and waste-strewn outskirts connecting the safe outpost to the hostile dungeon depths.

surface_outpost_staging_ground.name: Surface Outpost & Staging Ground
surface_outpost_staging_ground.purpose: A bustling surface encampment where adventurers purchase supplies, form expedition parties, and register before descending into the infinite dungeon.

the_abyssal_rift.name: The Abyssal Rift
the_abyssal_rift.purpose: Master delvers confront reality-warping horrors and eldritch puzzles to claim legendary artifacts.

the_magma_crucible.name: The Magma Crucible
the_magma_crucible.purpose: High-tier adventurers navigate searing volcanic hazards to battle fire constructs, harvest rare ores, and access ancient elemental forging machinery.

the_sunken_arboretum.name: The Sunken Arboretum
the_sunken_arboretum.purpose: Adventurers navigate a subterranean jungle of bioluminescent flora and tangled giant roots to harvest rare alchemical reagents and battle venomous monstrosities.

the_upper_catacombs.name: The Upper Catacombs
the_upper_catacombs.purpose: Novice adventurers navigate dusty, trap-laden crypts to battle basic monsters, solve simple mechanical puzzles, and scavenge starter gear.
